descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to help scientists and clinicians discover answers to research questions related to antibiotic-resistant bacterial infections, and the role that phage therapy plays as a possible treatment.

bioSpec.description: whole blood and synovial fluid will be stored in the biorepository for future research.

primaryOutcomes.description: To recruit and enroll participants up to 100 participants who have received or will receive phage therapy treatment
Total number of biospecimens collected which may include blood samples and synovial fluid
Review the medical record of enrolled participants to ascertain any new health outcomes.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Increase treatment options and level of care for patients with bacterial infections
primaryOutcomes.description: Total number of collaborations with clinical investigators and researchers at both Mayo Clinic and across the globe.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥ 18 years of age.
* Able to provide informed consent.
* Individual must have a future treatment plan to receive or has historically received phage therapy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals , 18 years of age.
* Unwilling/unable to provide informed consent.
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Mayo Clinic patients receiving bacteriophage therapy.
